ValidationRule.description: If the agent has marked the field "Is Translation call" as true and did not enter the Interpreter language, ID and Name in a Quality, Non Quality, Promotion and Ecommerce Case Complaints.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Is_Translation_Call__c , OR(ISBLANK( Interpreter_ID__c ), ISPICKVAL(Interpreter_Language__c , ''), ISBLANK( Interpreter_Name__c )),ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US'), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName == "NA_Non_Quality", RecordType.DeveloperName == "NA_Promotion", RecordType.DeveloperName == "NA_E_Commerce", RecordType.DeveloperName == "NA_Quality"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Interpreter name, Interpreter ID and Interpreter Language if case needs translator.
